name: secrets-redactor
description: Hides secrets, emails and IPs in tool output behind stable placeholders, restores them in tool input, and blocks hardcoded secrets in edits

secrets.title: Redact secrets
secrets.description: API keys, tokens, JWTs, private keys, passwords in connection strings and KEY= values

ips.title: Redact IPs
ips.description: IPv4 addresses (loopback and 0.0.0.0 are left alone)

allowlist.title: Allowlist
allowlist.description: Comma-separated regexes; a value matching any is never redacted

onSecret.title: On a secret
onSecret.description: redact: hide it; warn: leave it but flag it; stop: hide it and hold tool calls and prompts until you reply !secrets-ok

blockHardcoded.title: Block hardcoded secrets
blockHardcoded.description: Deny Write/Edit/MultiEdit whose new content hardcodes a secret (.env files excepted)
